📖 Reading: The Saturday Plan

Original A2 reading · Present simple, past simple and going to

On Saturday, Mia and her friends planned a small sports afternoon at the community centre. Mia usually plays volleyball, but this time she wanted to try basketball. At eleven o’clock, she met Leo outside the centre. Leo was wearing a blue cap and carrying a backpack. Their friend Sara arrived ten minutes later because her bus was late.

Inside the centre, there were two basketball courts and a café. The friends played for an hour. Mia couldn't score at first, but Leo gave her some advice. After the game, they bought sandwiches and juice. Sara spent six dollars, and Mia saved her money because she was going to buy a birthday present for her brother.

Before going home, they decided to meet again next weekend. “Let's invite Noah too,” said Sara. “Great idea!” replied Mia. They were tired, but everyone agreed it was a brilliant afternoon.

Challenge 1 — Food words

Challenge 2 — Describe the people

Example: Evie has got curly hair.
